name: Pressure Point
caption: Gregg "Comet" Matthews and Sal DeFazio, managed by Capt. America and Guyana Princess, GIWF's own inaugural World Tag-Team Champions crowned in a Gold Rush tournament, dethroned by Jingoist at Wrestle Wrath a year later.

tenures.source: GIWF's own served Weekly War / PPV show scripts (promotions/giwf-weeklywar-1995/archive/).

identity.note: Coincidental name match to the unit pressure-point-icbinr, named on a different, later fed's own site index (icbinr, 1999); no shared evidence beyond the name.

name: Jingoist
caption: The Narcissist, Lt. Liberty and Major Hawk Hunter, managed by Mike Fitzgerald, a three-man combination that dethroned Pressure Point for the World Tag-Team Championship at Wrestle Wrath.

tenures.source: GIWF's own served title-lineage and rankings snapshots (promotions/giwf-weeklywar-1995/archive/).
tenures.note: Billed as a trio holding a Tag-Team title in the fed's own record, an oddity honestly preserved rather than trimmed to a pair.

name: The Storm Lords
caption: Cyclone and Hurricane, a masked tag team managed by Christopher Andrews, who fought Pressure Point to a time-limit draw for the World Tag-Team title in October 1995 and remained bitter Arsenal rivals into 1996.

tenures.source: GIWF's own served Weekly War / PPV show scripts (promotions/giwf-weeklywar-1995/archive/).
